messages:
morgan: Quick follow-up from the postmortem (routing-induced evictions). Need owners for runbook/playbook edits and short commands for oncall. Keep it tight.

kevin: I can own the runbook text changes: add triage checklist, immediate mitigations, and a "when to abort rollout" box. Due 2024-10-06. Owner: @kevin.

anya: I'll add exact diagnostic commands and a small telemetry dump snippet. Example:```
# check per-variant qps and p99
redwoodctl metrics variant --route=converse --window=5m
# dump kv stats to file
curl -s http://localhost:9090/debug/kv > /tmp/kv.json
```

ravi: I'll draft the escalation flow and the alert rule (p99 spike + error-rate). Will also own the gating policy for rollouts. Due 2024-10-08.

kevin: Proposed action tickets:
- RW-INC-4720 runbook edits (owner: kevin) due 2024-10-06
- RW-INC-4721 diag commands + snippets (owner: anya) due 2024-10-04
- RW-INC-4722 escalation & gating (owner: ravi) due 2024-10-08

ops-bot: Reminder: add two approvers (SRE + Routing) on PRs. I will post reminders 48h before due dates.

morgan: Thanks — can we also add a 90-day review cadence (monthly checks for regressions)? Add as checklist item in each ticket.

anya: Will include that and a tiny repro payload sample in RW-INC-4721.

ravi: I'll add safe-revert commands in the playbook and a canary rollout pattern (5% -> 25% -> 100%) with monitoring gates.

kevin: I'll open the runbook PR and tag @anya and @ravi as reviewers. PR link when ready.

ops-bot: Thread archived after 72h of inactivity.
